models.review: Reviewed Session.save serialization and expected-byte replacement against deterministic concurrent-writer and cleanup controls; retain original safety/liveness checks. Reporting review 2026-10-22: the status orchestrator preserves every existing behavior/trace/TLC command and strict counterexample gate; weekly CI and timestamp/input-bound reports add no model or runtime semantic changes. Freshness and phase-failure controls remain separate from behavioral refinement. Runtime trace review 2026-10-22: bounded production action observations now instantiate the unchanged original Init/Next and all faithful safety invariants; required positive witnesses and implementation-only mutants are independently checked by TLC. Temporal fairness and universal refinement are not inferred from finite traces. TLC harness review: Java standard-module extraction is scoped to each owned invocation directory; invariant/counterexample acceptance and all model semantics are unchanged. Monitoring/exploration review 2026-10-22: read-only daily freshness monitor and deterministic bounded schedules add evidence without changing model semantics, source-baseline policy or existing positive/mutation obligations. Coverage documents real versus simulated boundaries.
